tokens.name: pond-deep
tokens.usage: Page background (deep water at night, morning water by day).

tokens.name: pond
tokens.usage: Cards, the trade box, panels on pond-deep.

tokens.name: pond-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, hovered rows, segmented controls, chips on pond.

tokens.name: reed
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, dividers, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: reed-strong
tokens.usage: Input border on hover; the empty part of the Leap meter.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers, on pond-deep, pond and pond-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, timestamps, on pond-deep, pond and pond-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only (large or non-essential); 3:1 on pond.

tokens.name: lily
tokens.usage: Brand green. Primary button fill, buy side, positive change, links. As text on pond-deep, pond, pond-raised.

tokens.name: lily-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind lily text: selected chips, buy tab, positive pills.

tokens.name: on-lily
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lily fill (primary button).

tokens.name: firefly
tokens.usage: The Leap and $PONDPAD as a fill: Leap meter near 100%, $PONDPAD button, spotlight border. Text on it is on-firefly. Never text on the pond grounds (use firefly-ink).

tokens.name: firefly-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text: Frog chip, 'just leapt', early-bird tax. On pond-deep, pond and firefly-soft.

tokens.name: firefly-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind firefly text: 'About to Leap' spotlight, Frog chip.

tokens.name: on-firefly
tokens.usage: Text on a firefly fill.

tokens.name: lotus
tokens.usage: The Chorus (IMD swarm): website and audit badges, swarm job links; X verified badge. As text on the pond grounds.

tokens.name: lotus-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind lotus text.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Sell side, negative change, errors. Always with a word or arrow, never color alone.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind coral text: sell tab, error notice.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text on a coral fill (sell button).

tokens.name: ripple
tokens.usage: Leap meter water fill, chart line for IMD price, focus ring. Marks only (3:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every ground.

families.display: "Lilita One", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero

styles.name: title

styles.name: lead

styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in running text, table values, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, card labels, tab labels.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The one key figure in a panel (curve raised, sPONDPAD value). Tabular numbers.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Addresses, tx hashes, ticker in tables. Shortened to 4…4.

styles.name: ticker
styles.usage: Coin tickers on cards and in the ripple feed.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, coin images, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the trade box, modals. Lily-pad round.

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.usage: Floating things only: trade box on mobile (bottom sheet), menus, toasts. Cards at rest have a border, not a shadow.
